labels.name: triage:security-report
labels.rationale: Cancelled eth_getLogs requests never leave the matcher, so each disconnect permanently parks indexLock readers. Repeated calls can grow goroutines without bound and livelock log-index rendering until restart.

labels.name: type:bug
labels.rationale: Concrete defect in core/filtermaps: the matcher coordinator does not observe request cancellation, so disconnected eth_getLogs handlers and their workers never exit.

result: Labels will be added to #35630: triage:security-report, type:bug
